title: Kandy 日帰りツアー
seoTitle: Kandy 日帰りツアー | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private Kandy 日帰りツアー with Temple of the Tooth and highland scenery.
shortDescription: Temple of the Tooth, scenic hills, and the cultural heart of the highlands.
overview:
A private day into Sri Lanka's hill capital, centred on the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic — one of the island's most important Buddhist sites. Explore the temple complex, observe local devotion, and soak in the lakeside setting of Kandy.
Enjoy panoramic viewpoints over the city and surrounding hills, with optional time at the Royal Botanical Gardens or other highland highlights. Your chauffeur guide keeps the day flexible so you can linger where the atmosphere feels right.
